_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Working out the final exam score

description: Use this when the user asks what score they need on a final exam to get a course grade ("I have an 85 and the final is 20%, what do I need for a 90"). Takes the current course grade %, the final exam weight %, and the desired course grade %; returns the score needed on the final, flags when it is impossible (above 100%, or above the max with extra credit) or already secured (any score works), the highest and lowest possible course grades, and the score needed for an A, B, C, or D (90/80/70/60). Assumes the current grade covers the rest of the course weight. Does not calculate GPA (use calculate_gpa) and does not handle point-based gradebooks with unknown category weights.

current_grade_pct.description: Current course grade before the final, as a percent, e.g. 85.

final_weight_pct.description: How much the final exam counts toward the course grade, as a percent greater than 0, e.g. 20.

max_final_score_pct.description: Highest possible score on the final, default 100. Raise it only if the final has extra credit, e.g. 105.

target_grade_pct.description: Course grade wanted after the final, as a percent, e.g. 90.

name: final_grade_needed
title: Final exam grade needed
